case_name: Board of Muslim Wakfs v Hadi Begum Smt. and Others

statutes.act: Provided For Appointment Of A Commissioner Of Wakfs And Additional Or Assistant Commissioner Of Wakfs For The Purpose Of Making A Survey Of Wakf Properties Existing In The State At The Date Of Commencement Of The Act
Was To Make A Survey Of Wakf Property Existing In The State At The Date Of The Commencement Of The Act
Or Under Section 17 And That It Was Not The Case Of The State That Any Act
Act Were Not Open To Challenge Before The High Court Under Article 226 Of The Constitution

holding: The judgment of the Division Bench of the High Court setting aside the order of the Wakfs Commissioner dated July 9, 1962 and declaring as invalid the inclusion of the land measuring 31 bighas and 3 biswas, in excess of land measuring 1 bigha and 17 biswas on which the mosque and the makbara are situated, in the list of wakf properties published in the Rajasthan Gazette date December 2, 1965, as amended by the subsequent notification dated June 29, 1967, cannot be upheld and must be set aside.
